name: crm-toolbar
title: Company toolbar
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Search, a segment bar, and a multi-select facet menu. A toolbar under 640px opens the same facets in a sheet.

meta.descriptionEs: Búsqueda, segmentos y un menú de facetas con selección múltiple. En un contenedor estrecho las facetas van a un panel.

examples.title: Segmentos
examples.description: Todas, Activas, Prospectos e Inactivas, más dos facetas.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px abre el panel. También un rótulo sin espacios.

meta.usage:
<CrmToolbar
  query={query}
  onQueryChange={setQuery}
  segment={segment}
  onSegmentChange={setSegment}
  segments={segments}
  facets={facets}
  selection={selection}
  onSelectionChange={setSelection}
/>

api.name: query / segment
api.description: Controlled search and segment. Segments default to All, Active, Lead, and Churned.

api.name: facets / selection
api.description: Each facet is multi-select. Values inside one facet match with OR. Facets match with AND.

api.name: layout
api.description: auto uses the toolbar width. Under 640px the facets open in a sheet.

api.name: labels
api.description: Search, segment group, filter button, sheet, and clear. Defaults are English.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by github.com/kargulstudio/sales-crm, which publishes no license. No source, class names, colors, copy, or assets were copied. Search uses search-field. Segments use segmented-control. filter-toolbar remains the single-value chip bar. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite badge, button, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, or sheet. The item ships no theme. The segment bar is a group of pressed buttons. Facet choices are checkboxes.
